surfaces.label: Authentication, forced password changes, account reset and session revocation
surfaces.notes: Development candidate baseline-auth-001 fixed: fresh user row is locked, current hash and auth_version are rechecked during password change. Independent rereview and regression test pass. Argon2id, rate limits, active check and regenerated sessions reviewed.

surfaces.label: Server-side employee ownership, administrator roles and reference IDs
surfaces.notes: Policies, scoped queries, controller guards, input allowlists and filters reviewed across trips, vehicles, templates, profiles, settlements, reports and exports. IDOR/BOLA and admin-denial tests pass, including manipulated IDs and export filters.

surfaces.label: Historical financial records and rate-relevant vehicle changes
surfaces.notes: Development candidate baseline-history-001 fixed in controller and PostgreSQL trigger: history-bearing vehicle fields immutable except active/default metadata. Rules and approved snapshots immutable; exact scaled-integer financial calculations, transactions and regression tests reviewed.

surfaces.label: CSV/XLSX/PDF export and spreadsheet formula interpretation
surfaces.notes: Development XLSX formula issue fixed by explicit StringCell values. Actual ZIP worksheet XML regression confirms no formula elements. CSV formula neutralization, output scoping and escaped PDF snapshot view reviewed; remote PDF fetching disabled.

surfaces.label: Historical CSV import and logo upload
surfaces.notes: Admin-only private staged upload, preview/mapping/validation and transaction rollback reviewed. File limits, private paths, PNG re-encoding, no SVG and private-resource authorization inspected; atomic import tests pass.

surfaces.label: Trip and settlement workflows, concurrency and audit
surfaces.notes: Status transitions, ownership locks, complete submission validation, odometer consistency, overlaps, decimal equality and correction reasons checked. Audit excludes credentials, PostgreSQL guards historical mutations; native tests pass.

surfaces.label: Browser requests, templates, error reporting and technical logs
surfaces.notes: Blade escaping, CSRF default middleware, request allowlists, no unsafe raw user HTML, no secret payload logging; HttpOnly/SameSite and actual HTTP CSRF419 confirmed in browser. German error responses do not show internal details.

surfaces.label: Production container and backup runtime boundaries
surfaces.notes: Docker/Compose/Nginx/FPM/entrypoint/scheduler/backup/restore source reviewed; db unpublished, secrets generated in volumes, app non-root, healthchecks and restart defined. Native pg_dump/pg_restore verified, Compose config validated. Missing Docker daemon prevents image/volume/container runtime validation.
